name: Ur-Yuuzhan Vong
description: The Ur-Yuuzhan Vong were a extra-galactic sentient, species from Yuuzhan'tar in a distant galaxy. Ur-Yuuzhan Yong lived as symbiotes with their homeworld and the species as a whole. Ur-Yuuzhan Yong were the ancestral species of the Yuuzhan Vong, which they devolved into after they were cut off from the Force.
